comment: The split between the plain and the shuffled outputs is at SCMCore.cc:217 and SCMCore.cc:226: jacks 0, 1 and 7, printed x1, x2 and x8, are driven straight, while jacks 2 to 6, printed S3 to S8, take the skip pattern and the slip offset. The multiples are set at SCMCore.cc:71-75, where the seventh output is forced to the same multiple as the eighth, so S8 and x8 both run at eight times with rotate at zero. The 4X FAST and MUTE jacks reverse their buttons rather than acting on their own (SCMCore.cc:39-44).
